parameters.content:
# REQUIRED BEFORE ACTIVATION

Complete these items before activating this deploy controller:

## n8n production checklist
- Set up error notifications or an error workflow.
- Configure time saved tracking if you want reporting.
- Enable MCP access only if this workflow must be exposed to MCP clients.

## Deployment configuration
- Configure DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_SECRET in n8n and GitHub Actions.
- Configure DEPLOY_APPROVAL_TOKEN.
- Configure TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_APPROVAL_CHAT_ID.
- Configure PUBLIC_N8N_BASE_URL and webhook URLs.
- Confirm NODES_EXCLUDE=[] and N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false are set.

## Safety review
- Keep production imports inactive until reviewed manually.
- Confirm /files/git is mounted and writable by the n8n container.
